source.author: verg
source.text: Vina bonus quae deinde cadis onerarat Acestes litore Trinacrio dederatque abeuntibus heros, dividit, et dictis maerentia pectora mulcet:
source.text_original: Vina bonus quae deinde cadis onerarat Acestes / litore Trinacrio dederatque abeuntibus heros, / dividit, et dictis maerentia pectora mulcet: /
source.text_english: The good Acestes then divides the wine, which he had loaded into jars on the Trinacrian shore and had given to the departing heroes, and with his words soothes their grieving hearts:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hanc mihi Pallas et soror hanc inquit mulcens mea pectora fletu abstulerint; veniant Phariae Tyriaeque carinae permissumque putent.
reuse.text_original: 'hanc mihi Pallas / et soror hanc' inquit 'mulcens mea pectora fletu / abstulerint; veniant Phariae Tyriaeque carinae / permissumque putent.
reuse.text_english: Pallas, and my sister, she says, while soothing my heart with tears, have taken this from me; let the Pharian and Tyrian ships come, and let them think it is permitted.
